messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['In my department we discovered an abandoned sum of $10.5m US dollars (Ten a million, five hundred thousand US dollars).', 'The bid that you entered for the item (200351371549) has been cancelled.', 'This Email is to notify you that your recent request to deactivate this email will be processed shortly.', 'We noticed some unauthorized login attempts to your mailbox.', 'Your account has been limited until we hear from you PP-503-472-206', 'We recently have determined that different computers have logged onto your Online Banking account, and multiple password failures were present before the logons.', 'We are introducing some exciting security changes that will make your online banking experience even better.', 'You have three important security messages from Entrust Bank Security team.', 'Vote care fancier est suspended, car nous Avon Remarque un problem SUR vote care.', 'Your account has been suspended.', "We're letting you know that we detected several failed attempts to sign in to your Bank of America account on 03/29/2016.", 'We have recently improved our online banking features for our members and have introduced a new security feature as part of our commitment to keep our members safe.', 'You have received 1 new message from Abbey National plc.', 'You have one new security message.', 'After the last annual calculation of your fiscal activity we have determined that you are eligible to receive a tax rebate of: 143.24', 'You have not used the telephone banking service for some time now and this could lead to a temporary deactivation your access to this service.', 'Your access to Online Services has been suspended due to a mismatch of access code between your Security details.', 'I am very happy to inform you about my success in getting that fund', 'Yahoo! Mail announces you as one of the 25 lucky winners in the ongoing 12 Years Yahoo lottery Award of the New Year Held on 4th of July 2011.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
